text_blocks.snippet: Small businesses in North Carolina have access to a variety of loan options, including those offered through the Small Business Administration (SBA) and other lenders. SBA loans, such as the 7(a) and 504 loan programs, are popular due to their potentially lower interest rates and longer repayment terms. Other options include traditional bank loans, equipment financing, and working capital loans, as well as specialized programs like microloans and Kiva loans.
